title_zh: 出院前约好私下核对用药文件

scenario.label_zh: 出院前请医护核对用药文件
scenario.goal_zh: 说明用药文件的疑问，约定私下由护士核对后再办理出院

context_zh: 虚构医院中，准备出院的患者在护士台询问文件；不提供实际用药剂量。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Are you going to discharge me before someone explains these tablets?

sentences.speaker: Nurse Patel
sentences.text: No. We still need to go through your paperwork. What is unclear?

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: The label gives a dose, but I cannot tell when I should take it next. Is that in the documentation?

sentences.speaker: Nurse Patel
sentences.text: It should be, but I will check the prescription with your nurse rather than guess.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Could we do that somewhere private? I do not want to describe my symptoms in the corridor.

sentences.speaker: Nurse Patel
sentences.text: Of course. Your privacy and dignity matter. The consultation room is free.

sentences.speaker: Owen
sentences.text: Thank you. I will wait there and keep the paperwork with me.

sentences.speaker: Nurse Patel
sentences.text: I will bring your nurse in, and we will clarify the instructions before you leave.
